title: World Cup Hosts Through History
description: From Uruguay 1930 to North America 2026 — do you know who hosted?

questions.q: Which country hosted the very first World Cup in 1930?
questions.explain: Uruguay hosted and won the inaugural tournament.

questions.q: Which three nations co-host the 2026 World Cup?
questions.explain: The first 48-team World Cup spans the USA, Canada and Mexico.

questions.q: Which two countries co-hosted the 2002 World Cup?
questions.explain: 2002 was the first World Cup held in Asia, and the first co-hosted.

questions.q: Which country hosted the 2010 World Cup?
questions.explain: South Africa hosted the first World Cup on the African continent.

questions.q: Where was the 2022 World Cup held?
questions.explain: Qatar hosted the first winter World Cup, in November–December.

questions.q: Which country hosted the 1966 World Cup?
questions.explain: England hosted and won their only title in 1966.

questions.q: Mexico has hosted the World Cup in which two years?
questions.explain: Mexico hosted in 1970 and 1986; in 2026 it becomes the first to host three.

questions.q: Which country hosted the 2018 World Cup?
questions.explain: Russia hosted in 2018; France won the title.

questions.q: Which country hosted the 1994 World Cup, the first to be decided in a penalty shootout final?
questions.explain: The USA hosted the 1994 World Cup — the first held in North America. Brazil beat Italy 3–2 on penalties in the Rose Bowl, the first World Cup final decided by a shootout.

questions.q: Italy hosted and won the World Cup in which year?
questions.explain: Italy hosted and won the 1934 World Cup under coach Vittorio Pozzo, becoming the first host nation to win the tournament. They also defended their title in France in 1938.
